Some things should be yours to tell. Who you confide in. Where you go. What you’re planning. Someone with access to your accounts could piece it together before you notice. Toza builds and tests digital protection with you, in person. Start with a free private conversation Message on WhatsApp · Message on Signal Opens messaging. It does not book an appointment or start a call. Before you get in touch Protection built around your next steps Toza agrees a written scope with you and protects the accounts, devices and sharing you rely on. One senior expert makes and tests the agreed changes with you in person. Toza can help close an old sign-in you are authorized to manage after explaining what could stop working or trigger a notification. How to begin Start with a free private conversation, usually 10–20 minutes. The Private Exposure Assessment costs ₪4,000 for about half a day in person. You receive a written exposure summary and priorities. It includes urgent first aid you approve where safe and within scope. What protection costs Protection is agreed separately. Personal Shield for one person costs ₪32,000. The assessment fee is credited in full when protection begins within 30 days of assessment completion. Protection includes a private dated record, a follow-up visit and a 60-day question line.
